core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Cyberpunk aesthetics with Swiss typographic precision.
Emotion First: Every interaction must feel 'Secure' yet 'Effortless'.
Content is King: The biometric data (waveforms, camera feed) is the hero.
Negative Space: Use deep black space to make the neon accents pop.
Contrast: High contrast (Cyan on Deep Navy) for legibility and impact.
anti_patterns: No static borders - use glowing/tracing borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Update 'tailwind.config.js' to include the custom colors (background: #0A0A1A, primary: #00FFFF).
3. FONTS: Import 'Unbounded' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts in 'index.css'.
4. LAYOUT: Create a 'MainLayout' component that centers the content and applies the background texture.
5. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI components but HEAVILY customize them with the 'visual_enhancers' classes defined above. Do not use default Shadcn styles.
6. ANIMATION: Implement the 'Heartbeat PPG' using a CSS keyframe animation or Framer Motion on an SVG path.
7. LIVENESS: Use a simple HTML5 Video element for the camera feed, wrapped in an oval mask (overflow-hidden + border-radius).
8. CRITICAL: Ensure all text has sufficient contrast against the dark background. Use 'text-cyan-400' for highlights.
10. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
